inputs.name: CpuUsageService.constructor.adapter
inputs.description: Adapter that supplies CPU readings through sample() for the before-and-after measurement. Defaults to new CpuProcessAdapter(); sampling or metric failures are returned as an unavailable snapshot.

outputs.name: CpuUsageService.snapshot
outputs.description: Promise resolving to a CPU snapshot produced from two adapter readings with a 1,000 ms wait between them. Calls during an in-flight measurement share its promise, and measurement failures resolve to an unavailable snapshot.
